title: Existence and upper semicontinuity of the mass density from exponential monotonicity of ball masses
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n). Write m(W) := M_W(T) = T.massOn W ∈ [0, ∞], ω_n := unitBallVolume n and B_t(z) := ball z t. Assume two conditions. (F) Every y ∈ U has some r > 0 with M_{B_r(y)}(T) < ∞. (M) For every compact K ⊆ U there is Λ ≥ 0 such that, for all y ∈ ℝ^P and R ∈ ℝ with closedBall y R ⊆ K, the function ρ ↦ ofReal(e^{Λρ}/ρ^n)·M_{B_ρ(y)}(T) is nondecreasing on (0, R). Then there is Θ : ℝ^P → ℝ with two properties. First, HasMassDensity T y (Θ(y)) for every y ∈ U, i.e. Θ(y) ≥ 0 and M_{B_ρ(y)}(T)/(ω_n·ofReal(ρ^n)) → ofReal(Θ(y)) in [0, ∞] as ρ ↓ 0. Second, Θ is upper semicontinuous on U (UpperSemicontinuousOn Θ U).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → (∀ y ∈ U, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ T.massOn (ball y r) ≠ ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ Λ : ℝ, 0 ≤ Λ ∧ ∀ (y : Euclid P) (R : ℝ), closedBall y R ⊆ K → MonotoneOn (fun ρ : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (Λ * ρ) / ρ ^ n) * T.massOn (ball y ρ)) (Ioo 0 R)) → ∃ Θ : Euclid P → ℝ, (∀ y ∈ U, HasMassDensity T y (Θ y)) ∧ UpperSemicontinuousOn Θ U
